    41	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    42	    P.glueData.glued ⟶ Spec (.of P.N.1) := by
    43	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.L.1 k := by infer_instance
    44	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.M.1 k := by infer_instance
    45	  let A : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Type u := fun U =>
    46	    Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U
    47	  let B : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Type u :=
    48	    fun U V =>
    49	      Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V
    50	  let r : ∀ U V, A U →ₐ[P.N.1] B U V := fun U V =>
    51	    pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
    52	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V
    53	  letI : ∀ U V, Algebra (A U) (B U V) := fun U V =>
    54	    pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap (r U V)
    55	  letI : ∀ U V, IsScalarTower P.N.1 (A U) (B U V) := fun U V =>
    56	    pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap (r U V)
    57	  let tau : ∀ U V, B V U →ₐ[P.N.1] B U V := fun U V =>
    58	    pic0FiniteStageTransitionBaseChange
    59	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V

    61	  · intro U
    62	    change Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C at U
    63	    exact Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A U)))
    64	  · rintro ⟨U, V⟩
    65	    change Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C at U V
    66	    change
    67	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A U) (B U V))) ≫
    68	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A U))) =
    69	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tau U V).toRingHom) ≫
    70	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A V) (B V U)))) ≫
    71	            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A V)))
    72	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    73	    rw [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    74	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]

    76	    ext x
    77	    simp only [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    78	      ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    79	      AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, Category.assoc, RingHom.coe_coe]
    80	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P.N.1 (A U) (B U V)]
    81	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P.N.1 (A V) (B V U)]
    82	    exact (tau U V).commutes x |>.symm

    85	noncomputable def gluedOver
    86	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    87	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) : Over (Spec (.of P.N.1)) :=
    88	  Over.mk P.gluedMap

    90	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage

    92	end

    31	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    32	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)

    38	  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
    39	    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
    40	  have e_inv_fst : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV := by
    41	    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).fst = _
    42	    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
    43	      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
    44	  exact
    45	    asIso (pullback.map
    46	      (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV
    47	      (pullback.snd g (iU ≫ f) ≫ iU) iV
    48	      (pullbackSymmetry (iU ≫ f) g).hom (𝟙 V) (𝟙 X)
    49	      (by simp) (by simp)) ≪≫

    51	    pullbackSymmetry g (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) ≪≫
    52	    asIso (pullback.map
    53	      (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) g
    54	      (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g
    55	      e.inv (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z)
